Title: Portal page hangs
Application: DataPortal
Description of Issue: We are trying to pull data from DataPortal, but the page hangs and becomes unresponsive. IIS returns 408. The SQL call behind the page then fails with: Execution Timeout Expired. The timeout period elapsed prior to completion of the operation or the server is not responding.

Title: IIS Site down
Application: Web Server 30324-Web01
Description of Issue: We can't reach the web server for the posix-mark application. We are seeing IIS 503.0. The app pool is stopped after a recycle.

Ticket Number: API000-42447
Title: Session terminated trying to connect to Secret Server.
Application: Secret Server
Description of Issue: We are trying to SSO into Secret Server to retrieve passwords, but we get an access denied message (HTTP 401), and the session terminates with OKTA E0000011 Invalid token provided.

Ticket Number: API000-42449
Title: BeterBarter FX has not received funds.
Application: TrueFX
Description of Issue: Customer submitted a transaction, and they have not seen the funds arrive. Our outbound POST to the BeterBarter FX vendor API returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After: 60. Callers then guessed port 13547 might be closed, but our IIS site is fine.
